reasoning: On the season so far the Magic are the stronger team; with home court the Magic start about 2 points better, in a game of about 235 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Magic.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bulls (confidence).
Bottom line: the Magic win 57 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 207 and 255 total points.
